correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full inspectable contract: PR-number and env validation (INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults), canonical allow-list load with [bot] stripping, paginated GraphQL for reviews and reviewThreads (including follow-on comment pages), pre- and post-snapshot head SHA checks, in-memory-only state, and RESULT=/HEAD= emissions for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with the documented exit codes. CONVERGED correctly requires at least one participating allow-listed bot, zero unresolved bot-rooted threads, and every participant to have a non-PENDING terminal review on the pinned head with no pending review on head. One-point deduction: bots that participate only via thread comments without a submitted review on the current head cannot satisfy terminal_for_head, so settle may rely on QUIET_ELAPSED rather than CONVERGED even when threads are resolved—a reasonable but slightly narrow reading of “terminal for the current head.”

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent: set -euo pipefail, REPO_ROOT resolution, small named shell helpers, structured jq summarization, and a documented canonical scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt. Docs are thoroughly synced—pr-resolve-all.md adds a settle-window section preferring the helper while preserving the time-based sleep fallback; AI_REPO_GUIDE.md gains tree/table entries and verification commands; agent-pipeline.md points at the canonical allow-list; workflow mirrors add cursor alongside allow-list alignment comments. Check wiring via scripts/checks/159-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh follows existing pass/fail plus run_bats_check patterns. Minor deduction for a ~540-line monolithic script with large inline jq rather than extracted filters.

process.rationale: Diff stays focused on the task surfaces: helper, allow-list, prompt, guide, companion agent-pipeline doc, dedicated check 159, and bats coverage. pr-resolve-all.md prefers scripts/pr-resolve-all-poll.sh, documents result dispatch and env overrides, and explicitly retains the documented QUIET_WINDOW sleep fallback. Workflow edits are limited to aligning reviewer lists with the canonical allow-list (cursor) rather than unrelated churn. No AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or compliance-fixture noise appears in files-changed.txt; objective process scored 15/15.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is credible: scripts/checks/159-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh existence-greps the helper and prompt reference then invokes run_bats_check; objective test_wiring matched 2/2, bash -n passed, and lint-shell-conventions passed. The bats suite mock-tests all five result branches (CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, missing-allowlist API_ERROR) and adds allow-list parity plus discoverability guards across prompt, relay workflow, agent-pipeline, and AI_REPO_GUIDE. Gaps: no stub coverage for gh auth/repo/GraphQL API_ERROR paths; bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective grading so runtime pass is unverified in this bundle.

uncertainty_notes: bats_poll_helper and full_test_sh were skipped in objective-grade.json; subjective reliability assumes the mock-gh bats cases are structurally sound but not runtime-verified in this bundle.

emit_result prints RESULT= and HEAD= on stdout and exits with codes 0/2/3/4 matching CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, and API_ERROR.
Poll loop compares PRE_HEAD and POST_HEAD to PINNED_HEAD and exits 3 with RESULT=SHA_CHANGED when head differs before or after each snapshot.
summarize_snapshot_json converged requires participants length > 0, zero unresolved bot-rooted threads, and all bot_states terminal_for_head with no pending_for_head.

QUIET_ELAPSED exits 0 when ELAPSED since latest_actionable_at meets or exceeds QUIET_WINDOW; TIMEOUT exits 2 when TOTAL_WAIT meets MAX_WAIT.
